reading_issues: Full-page Propagation Labs PNG, mirrored layout with a one-column 'Grain Form' table at the right (glyphs only for 4 thin/short layers). Heights from 10 cm gridlines (10.75 px/cm; HS 240 at y=355.5, blue PIT 115 line at y=1698.5): the lower 115 cm of snowpack is not dug. Hardness axis tick spacing differs from the other charts (K/P/1F/4F/F at x=348.5/718.5/1088/1458/1828). Filename 'TL S aspect' and header (aspect S, 2380 m) agree. The CT23SP label gives the failure on an FC ('[square]') layer named 'Jan 24', and the notes say 'Failed above crust'; the line is at 165 cm (top of the 160-165 cm crust), but the grain column assigns the square glyph to the 150-160 cm layer below the crust, so the failure-layer height/identity is slightly ambiguous. Secondary open circle on the 147-150 crust read as MF, uncertain. 160-165 cm layer is tapered (layer mean). Air temp and blowing snow blank.
